candidate_workaround: Parse the two-character porcelain status prefix with anchored regular expressions, including an escaped literal question-mark pair for untracked rows.
failure_signature: A PowerShell -like pattern containing question marks treated them as single-character wildcards and classified all staged rows as untracked.
recurrence_guard: Use anchored regular expressions against the porcelain prefix and retain staged, unstaged, and untracked counts as separate fields.
rollback: Reject the wildcard-derived count, preserve the failed observation, and rerun the same immutable status rows through anchored prefix expressions.
scope_boundary: Owner-local Git status classification only; not repository correctness, remote equality, or independent reproduction.
title: Parse porcelain status prefixes with anchored regular expressions
